camel_example: aliyun live DeleteLiveMessageGroupMessage --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest --MessageId a74a8fbd3cfe4b2daa8517e4e3000000
description_en: Deletes a message that was sent to an interactive messaging group
description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveMessageGroupMessage删除（撤回）某条群组消息
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-live-message-group-message --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --message-id a74a8fbd3cfe4b2daa8517e4e3000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLiveMessageGroupMessage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message that you want to delete. Set this parameter to the value of MsgTid that you specified when you called the SendLiveMessageGroup operation. The ID must be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的消息ID，与发送消息中的MsgTid对应。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who deletes the message. The ID must be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 发起删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: deleter_id

parameters.help_en: The additional information about the user who performs the deletion operation. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 发起删除消息的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节
parameters.name: deleter_info

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the deleted or non-existent message
MessageId.description_zh: 已删除的或者不存在的消息ID
